//: Copy to appsettings.Development.json and fill in to enable Azure OpenAI.
appsettings.Development.json is git-ignored. Never put a real key in this file.
Environment variables take precedence: AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT, AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY,
AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT. Leave everything blank to run in deterministic demo mode,
in which the whole product still works.
